source_evidence: Exact player 'I am a viscount a huge estate, and a member of the crownsunder governing assembly… You need to show me your authorization' is V's spoken assertion of rank/estate/Assembly standing and demand for authorization; no new office, jurisdiction or automatic command conferred. V remains at wooded rise, no solo approach or papers surrendered. Fenar independently steps visibly alongside V, backing his demand without attacking, meaningful Help for coercive social pressure. New leverage after previous Persuasion result: predeclared Intimidation+7 (+6 skill, +1 Luckstone) advantage, DC16 officer pauses requisition and addresses challenge, DC21 additionally gives concrete identifying detail of alleged command, no result creates genuine orders or forces full confession. Executed Python secrets receipt batch401e26f5f66b2d6b669049be11ae5a2d d20 faces19,7 keep19+7=26, both thresholds succeed. P1 Veteran is unwilling to expose the detachment by immediately escalating against an apparent titled official with armed companions; he visibly signals/calls P4 to hold the collection temporarily. P4 obeys and stops the requisition activity, no completed removal of stores assumed. P1 repeats that there is no written authorization carried, but supplies a concrete claim: the quartermaster at the old Orseld toll-fort gave the requisition instruction, and that is where the supplies are meant to go. This is his spoken claim and actionable investigative lead consistent with fixed prepared depot and command structure, not proof of genuine Crown authority, confession, verified patron, directions, precise distance, or surrender. P1 asks whether V means to stop a supposed supply detail pending verification. No automatic compliance beyond temporary pause, no attack, initiative, signal, movement into gate/approach, confiscation, injury, spend or resource use. All fixed roster/positions and prior evidence preserved; V next choice.
